speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand your condition better, how old are you, and has anyone noticed any swelling or stiffness in your joints?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukemia (likely Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia)

The symptoms of fever, fatigue, bruising, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old are highly concerning for leukemia. To confirm this, I need to request a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and a peripheral smear.
